evaluation_scope: Gate-E schema-faithful fixture KG plus frozen asserted W5 ontology
negative_cq_interpretation: Negative CQs are regression/consistency checks over the frozen asserted ontology and fixture graph. Under OWL open-world semantics, absence of a queried pattern is not interpreted as proof that the pattern is impossible in the domain unless explicit formal axioms support that conclusion.

competency_questions.question: Which medicinal products are linked to their active pharmaceutical substances?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?product ?productLabel ?substance ?substanceLabel WHERE { ?product a cmpe:MedicinalProduct ; cmpe:hasActiveSubstance ?substance . ?substance a cmpe:PharmaceuticalSubstance . OPTIONAL { ?product rdfs:label ?productLabel } OPTIONAL { ?substance rdfs:label ?substanceLabel } } ORDER BY ?product

competency_questions.question: Which medicinal-product presentations instantiate which medicinal products?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> SELECT DISTINCT ?presentation ?product WHERE { ?presentation a cmpe:MedicinalProductPresentation ; cmpe:presentationOf ?product . ?product a cmpe:MedicinalProduct . } ORDER BY ?presentation

competency_questions.question: Which pharmaceutical facilities are linked to physical geography?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> SELECT DISTINCT ?facility ?geography WHERE { ?facility a cmpe:Facility ; cmpe:locatedIn ?geography . ?geography a ?geoType . FILTER(?geoType IN (cmpe:GeographicFeature, cmpe:AdministrativeRegion, cmpe:Country)) } ORDER BY ?facility

competency_questions.question: Can provenance be traversed from a dataset through its release to each source record?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> SELECT DISTINCT ?dataset ?release ?record WHERE { ?dataset a cmpe:Dataset ; cmpe:hasDatasetRelease ?release . ?release a cmpe:DatasetRelease ; cmpe:containsSourceRecord ?record . ?record a cmpe:SourceRecord . } ORDER BY ?dataset ?record

competency_questions.question: Can cross-source entity matches be represented with explicit confidence and a matched canonical presentation?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?match ?subject ?object ?confidence ?presentation WHERE { ?match a cmpe:EntityMatchAssertion ; cmpe:matchSubject ?subject ; cmpe:matchObject ?object ; cmpe:hasMatchConfidence ?q ; rdfs:seeAlso ?presentation . ?q a cmpe:MatchConfidence ; rdf:value ?confidence . ?presentation a cmpe:MedicinalProductPresentation . } ORDER BY ?match

competency_questions.question: Can medicinal-product presentations be resolved through explicit identifier assignments?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> SELECT DISTINCT ?presentation WHERE { ?assignment a cmpe:IdentifierAssignment ; cmpe:identifierEntity ?presentation ; cmpe:identifierScheme ?scheme ; cmpe:identifierLexicalValue ?value . ?presentation a cmpe:MedicinalProductPresentation . } ORDER BY ?presentation

competency_questions.question: Do projected reimbursement/utilisation observations retain subject, time, geography and source-record provenance?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT DISTINCT ?obs ?presentation ?time ?geo ?source WHERE { ?obs a cmpe:ReimbursementUtilisationObservationResult ; cmpe:observationResultAbout ?presentation ; cmpe:validFrom ?time ; dct:spatial ?geo ; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?source . ?presentation a cmpe:MedicinalProductPresentation . ?source a cmpe:SourceRecord . } ORDER BY ?obs

competency_questions.question: Does every evidence-support instance connect a source record to an assertion?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> SELECT DISTINCT ?support ?record ?assertion WHERE { ?support a cmpe:EvidenceSupport ; cmpe:evidenceRecord ?record ; cmpe:evidenceAssertion ?assertion . ?record a cmpe:SourceRecord . ?assertion a cmpe:Assertion . } ORDER BY ?support

competency_questions.question: Is Facility asserted or hierarchically modeled as a subclass of Organization?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { cmpe:Facility rdfs:subClassOf+ cmpe:Organization }

competency_questions.question: Is Medicinal Product asserted or hierarchically modeled as a subclass of Pharmaceutical Substance?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { cmpe:MedicinalProduct rdfs:subClassOf+ cmpe:PharmaceuticalSubstance }

competency_questions.question: Is Medicinal Product asserted or hierarchically modeled as a subclass of Medicinal Product Presentation?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { cmpe:MedicinalProduct rdfs:subClassOf+ cmpe:MedicinalProductPresentation }

competency_questions.question: Is Geographic Feature asserted or hierarchically modeled as a subclass of Regulatory Jurisdiction?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { cmpe:GeographicFeature rdfs:subClassOf+ cmpe:RegulatoryJurisdiction }

competency_questions.question: Is Medicine Shortage Situation asserted or hierarchically modeled as a Source Record?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { cmpe:MedicineShortageSituation rdfs:subClassOf+ cmpe:SourceRecord }

competency_questions.question: Is Observation Result asserted or hierarchically modeled as an Observation Activity?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { cmpe:ObservationResult rdfs:subClassOf+ cmpe:ObservationActivity }

competency_questions.question: Is Supply Capacity Observation Result asserted or hierarchically modeled as Supply Capacity itself?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { cmpe:SupplyCapacityObservationResult rdfs:subClassOf+ cmpe:SupplyCapacity }

competency_questions.question: Does any fixture observation result lack source-record provenance?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> ASK { ?obs a cmpe:ReimbursementUtilisationObservationResult . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?obs prov:wasDerivedFrom ?source . ?source a cmpe:SourceRecord . } }

competency_questions.question: Does any evidence-support instance fail to connect both a source record and an assertion?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> ASK { ?support a cmpe:EvidenceSupport . FILTER( NOT EXISTS { ?support cmpe:evidenceRecord ?record . ?record a cmpe:SourceRecord . } || NOT EXISTS { ?support cmpe:evidenceAssertion ?assertion . ?assertion a cmpe:Assertion . } ) }

competency_questions.question: Does any identifier assignment in the fixture lack its scheme, entity or lexical value?
competency_questions.sparql: PREFIX cmpe: <https://w3id.org/cm-pharme/2.0/> ASK { ?assignment a cmpe:IdentifierAssignment . FILTER( NOT EXISTS { ?assignment cmpe:identifierScheme ?scheme } || NOT EXISTS { ?assignment cmpe:identifierEntity ?entity } || NOT EXISTS { ?assignment cmpe:identifierLexicalValue ?value } ) }
